proposal.diagnosis: The total method in cartStore only accesses the first item's price at index 0 rather than reducing over all items and multiplying price by quantity.

edits.newContent: total: () => get().items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0),

proposal.unifiedDiff:
--- a/src/store/cartStore.ts
+++ b/src/store/cartStore.ts
@@ -64,1 +64,1 @@
-  total: () => get().items[0]?.price ?? 0,
+  total: () => get().items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0),
